items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren is inactive today (groin, previously questionable/GTD).
items.why: Groin injury suffered late in week.
items.implication: Colts TE stream needed; boost to other pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Targets to Josh Downs/Keenan Allen or streamers like Juwan Johnson/Freiermuth/Higbee.

items.text: Browns RB Quinshon Judkins (ankle, previously questionable/GTD) is officially out/inactive today vs Ravens.
items.why: Ankle injury; practiced limited once this week; pregame workout confirmed out.
items.implication: Browns RBs limited to Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime; Judkins owners need replacements.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for McLaughlin/Estime in Browns backfield.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams is active today.
items.why: Confirmed in Schefter actives list; ETR expected.
items.implication: Bears offense back to full QB strength; boost to pass-catchers.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave and RB Alvin Kamara are active today.
items.implication: Saints skill players available vs Giants.
items.opportunity: Full roles for Kamara carries and Olave targets.

items.text: Projections updated for all news including Judkins/Warren outs, Spears active; no word yet on DJ Moore/Josh Palmer.

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown and RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) are both officially active.
items.why: Rapoport prior likely; confirmed active. AJB activated earlier.
items.implication: Pats near full health; Brown returns, Henderson plays.
items.opportunity: Targets for Brown; carries for Henderson.

items.text: Tyler Warren out surprising; Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth and Higbee among favorite streamer TEs.
Titans RB Tyjae Spears is active today.
items.why: Confirmed active on Titans inactives; prior no word.
items.implication: Titans RB committee includes Spears; potential change vs prior expectations.

items.text: Updated ranks: Cam Skattebo RB28 (still start but riskier flex post-rotation), Najee Harris RB33. Prefer Najee over DK Metcalf in PPR for TD shot vs Saints run defense.
items.why: Rotation change after fumbles; explosiveness still gives score chance vs NO.
items.conflict: Still starts Cam over pure sit; Levitan highlights poor YOE.

items.text: Giants expected to change RB rotation: Najee Harris larger role, Cam Skattebo downgraded but still mixed after fumbles. Skattebo 37th/43 in rush YOE with 4 fumbles. All 4 RBs active.
items.why: Sources via Raanan; poor efficiency and fumbles.
items.opportunity: More snaps/carries for Najee Harris; Skattebo still explosive chance vs NO.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers starting Cam for explosiveness/score chance as flex over pure RB2.

items.text: Deebo Samuel not expected to play (hamstring).
items.why: ETR summary; confirmed out in reports.
items.implication: 49ers WR corps thinned (Evans also GTD Monday).
items.opportunity: More targets to Kittle/others if Evans limited.

items.text: Eagles placed Jalen Hurts on IR and signed/activated RB Jaydon Blue to active roster.
items.implication: Hurts out indefinitely; Blue available in backfield.
items.opportunity: RB snaps for Blue/Gainwell etc behind Barkley if healthy.

items.text: Actives include Kenyon Sadiq, Ja’Kobi Lane, Rico Dowdle (plus others).
Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) game-time decision for Monday vs WAS; questionable, limited/side work.
items.why: Missed practices; Shanahan decision near gametime.
items.implication: Monitor for MNF; high upside if plays vs weak secondary.
items.opportunity: If out, volume to Kittle/Cooks etc.

items.text: DK Metcalf and Pat Freiermuth expected to play (Metcalf cleared illness; Freiermuth Q but optimistic).
items.why: ETR summary; Metcalf removed from report.
